integrity: All statements are analytic deductions under stated quantifiers; the standalone finite checker is corroborating evidence, not a general proof. Known ellipse and contacts are attributed as prior results.
limitations: Angle-uniform independent rays and their centered convex hull only; congruent two-disk lenses in the Euclidean plane. No arclength-sampled or off-center analogue, no uniform fixed-c expansion at c=0, no independent historical-priority assessment.
title: A singular disk–lens crossover for near-maximal random inscribed parallelograms
